submission.reasoning: On workstation5, cmd.exe wrote C:\Users\wardog\AppData\Local\Temp\art.bat at 02:46:45.192Z on 2020-10-20. The same shell then launched elevated reg.exe as WORKSTATION5\wardog at 02:47:08.745Z to set HKCU\Environment\UserInitMprLogonScript to that batch file; the registry write was confirmed at 02:47:08.761Z. This establishes user-logon persistence through a script in a temporary directory, rather than an ordinary environment-variable update. No authorization or legitimate deployment evidence was present. Isolate the workstation, remove the logon-script value, and delete the batch payload. Payload contents, subsequent execution, and credential theft were not established.
